trigger: Concurrent ephemeral cache handle close and changed write fan-out
cause: Both operations held shared network locks; the subscription disappeared after the INSERT SELECT snapshot but before delivery foreign-key validation.
effect: Whole write transaction rolled back; no committed variable/event divergence.
fix: Acquire the network row exclusively before close, consistently before the subscription row and delivery rows.

verification.mechanism: BEFORE INSERT advisory-lock barrier holds the writer between fan-out selection and foreign-key validation; real close waits on the network row until commit.
